name: bedrock-real-ip
title: Bedrock/NetherNet real client address behind the relay
description: Establish where the address Geyser reports for a NetherNet player comes from (observed 10.1.1.120:0 with a same-LAN client on a public entry), decide which Geyser switch carries a real Bedrock address in this topology, and document the switch set and its constraints. No runtime or provider config changes until the design is agreed.
